text: Irrigation (ការស្រោចស្រព). Water requirements change through the growth cycle. Right after sowing, light, frequent watering is needed — around 1-2 times per day (morning and late afternoon, roughly 3-4pm) — until germination, which takes about 7-10 days. After germination, once the crop reaches the true-leaf stage (2-3 true leaves), water needs increase moderately and consistently as the root develops; irrigation should be applied evenly according to the crop's growth stage. Excessive, irregular, or inconsistent watering can cause root cracking, poor shape, and stunted or uneven growth, especially during hot weather, so consistent scheduling is emphasized over flooding.
